mandatory_conditions: Item must be purchased entirely with the covered Visa Infinite card (or associated rewards points)
Item must have a valid original manufacturer warranty of three (3) years or less
Claim must be reported within documented timeframe (typically 60-90 days from failure)
exclusions_and_caveats: This demonstration uses a representative Visa Infinite benefit configuration. Final coverage depends on the issuing bank, specific Guide to Benefits, documentation, and exclusions
Excludes motorized vehicles, computer software, real estate, and items purchased for commercial use
Cardholder must provide itemized store receipt, monthly billing statement, original warranty terms, and authorized repair diagnostic if requested
